subject: [PATCH] mm/mempolicy: convert mempolicy refcnt to refcount_t

reviews.author: SJ Park
reviews.summary: Reviewed the patch and found it to be correct. Acknowledged the change and provided a Reviewed-by tag.
reviews.raw_body:
On Thu, 15 Oct 2026 19:13:22 -0400 "Gregory Price (Meta)" <gourry@gourry.net> wrote:

> struct mempolicy uses an atomic_t as a pure reference counter.
> 
> Convert it to refcount_t so that overflow and underflow are caught
> by the refcount saturation checks.
> 
> This silences the atomic_as_refcounter.cocci warning, which started
> matching __mpol_put() when it switched kmem_cache_free() to kfree_rcu().
> 
> No functional change for correct callers.

Looks correct to me.

> 
> Reported-by: kernel test robot <lkp@intel.com>
> Closes: https://lore.kernel.org/oe-kbuild-all/202610061946.Bx22ZFrw-lkp@intel.com/
> Signed-off-by: Gregory Price (Meta) <gourry@gourry.net>

Reviewed-by: SJ Park <sj@kernel.org>


Thanks,
SJ

[...]

2026-10-15.patch_summary: This patch converts the reference counting mechanism in the memory policy (mempolicy) from atomic_t to refcount_t, which provides overflow and underflow protection. This change silences a static analysis warning related to __mpol_put() and kmem_cache_free(). The patch does not introduce any functional changes for correct callers.
